verdict_reason: The seeding change is correct, but it leaves the other-notification 404 test proving nothing about the handle, and no test shows document routes refusing another organisation.

todos.issue: shouldReturn404_whenTheHandleBelongsToAnotherNotification (lines 249-257) no longer proves its title: setUpDocuments seeds only NOTIFICATION_REF (line 181), so the GET to /notifications/GBN-AG-26-OTHER0/document-upload-sessions/{handle} now 404s in NotificationService.requireTraderAccess (DocumentController.java:123) because GBN-AG-26-OTHER0 does not exist for the caller's organisation, before documentService.findSession ever compares the handle with the notification. Deleting the ref check in findSession would leave this test green.
todos.fix: Must: the test reaches documentService.findSession with a notification the caller owns, so the 404 can only come from the handle belonging to another notification. One way: call ensureTraderNotification(notificationRepository, "GBN-AG-26-OTHER0") in the test (or a second constant seeded in setUpDocuments) before the GET.

todos.issue: This PR adds requireTraderAccess to the notification-scoped document routes (register, document-upload-sessions, list: DocumentController.java:93, :123, :174), but no test anywhere sends one of these requests from another organisation. This file only ever calls webClient("NoAuth") with DEFAULT_TRADER_ORG_ID, DocumentControllerTest stubs requireTraderAccess with doNothing() (line 79), and NotificationIT's cross-organisation tests (lines 2675-2754) cover notification routes only. The AC 'Tests show that a user in organisation A cannot see or change a notification that belongs to organisation B' is unproven for documents, and dropping any one of those three requireTraderAccess calls leaves the suite green.
todos.fix: Must: for each notification-scoped document route, a test sends the request with another organisation's header against a notification the default organisation owns and asserts 404. One way: a nested OtherOrganisation class here using webClient("NoAuth", OTHER_ORG_ID) for POST /notifications/{ref}/document-uploads, GET /notifications/{ref}/document-upload-sessions/{handle} and GET /notifications/{ref}/document-uploads, each expecting isNotFound().
